Extract keywords from <meta name='keywords'> tag

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<html><head><title>Page</title><meta name="keywords" content="rust, markdown, html, converter"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.metadata.document.keywords.inspect
```
